notes: bə + qereb is fused as among and carries the relative clause's copula, while the suffix keeps them (rules 30, 49).
Two waws in the wayyāšubû wayyibkû pair against one English and; the first takes it and the second is unrepresented (rule 42).
mixed multitude heads on multitude on rule 31's specifier reading; heading on mixed remains defensible and is named in the unit note.
The Hiphil of ʾakal takes shall give ... to eat as one discontinuous unit, headed on the complement (rule 44).
